ANNOUNCE.template:
ANNOUNCE rtsp_uri RTSP/1.0
CSeq: <sequence>
[Session: <session_id>]
Content-Type: application/sdp
Content-Length: <length>

<body>

DESCRIBE.template:
DESCRIBE rtsp_uri RTSP/1.0
CSeq: <sequence>
Accept: application/sdp

examples: optional, media type of body in response

PLAY.template:
PLAY rtsp_uri RTSP/1.0
CSeq: <sequence>
Session: <session_id>
Range: <range_spec>

RECORD.template:
RECORD rtsp_uri RTSP/1.0
CSeq: <sequence>
Session: <session_id>
Range: <range_spec>

SETUP.template:
SETUP rtsp_uri RTSP/1.0
CSeq: <sequence>
Session: <session_id>
Transport: <transport_params>

examples: required, session ID from previous SETUP or initial setup
